name: ThreadShelf
description: Index ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI Studio, OpenRouter, LM Studio and Grok exports locally for semantic and exact search, then continue old threads with local GGUF models.
compatibility: Runs GGUF models through a managed, loopback-only llama.cpp llama-server, with guided setup of an official llama.cpp build.
Serves its GGUF models over OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints at /v1 (chat/completions, completions, responses, messages).
Exposes archive search and full-thread reading to MCP clients through a stdio MCP server.
limitations: Single-user application: the HTTP API has no accounts or authentication and should stay on loopback unless deliberately exposed on a trusted network.
The local embedding model downloads once on first indexing; llama.cpp builds come from GitHub Releases and GGUF models from Hugging Face only when the user asks.
Optional OpenRouter generation is off-device: it sends the selected conversation history and prompt to OpenRouter and the routed provider.
Google AI Studio, OpenRouter, LM Studio and Grok exports use undocumented formats that can change without notice.
Requires Node.js 20.19 or newer; installed through npm (npx threadshelf).

sources.note: Supported sources, local embeddings and LanceDB storage, MCP stdio server, llama.cpp and OpenRouter generation, /v1 compatible endpoints, Windows/macOS/Linux data paths, privacy boundary, and the single-user, no-authentication limitation.
